records.Message:
Dear Valued Partner,
Thank you for contacting Tamara.

Your account balance is made up of two separate components:

1. Available Balance

This is your settled balance — the portion we can manually adjust. After our team processes the manual deposit, it will be added directly to this balance.

2. Pending Balance

This reflects transactions currently in motion — such as recent payment captures or refunds that haven't fully completed processing yet.


Why your balance may still not show as zero:

When we make a manual adjustment, we can only adjust your Available Balance to Zero. 

If you have a Pending negative balance (for example, from a recent refund or capture), that amount cannot be manually adjusted, it is adjusted automatically by our system at the end of your Payment Cycle.

So even after a manual adjustment, your overall balance may still show a remaining amount, this is your Pending Balance working through the system.

If you have further questions or your balance does not resolve after your cycle ends, please don't hesitate to reach out and we'll investigate further.

Best regards,
Partner care team.
